name: 99337 · Kennewick, WA
findings: ZIP 99337 (Kennewick) has 63 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 99337 (Kennewick) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 5 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
